'''Figaro''' is an Acolyte NPC in Ragunna Ciy, {{Location|City Square|nocat=1}}, by the [[Resonance Nexus|Genesis Nexus]].

{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
;(First interaction)
:'''Figaro:''' Light of Genesis, lift me up...
:'''Figaro:''' There's dust here again, better wipe it off quickly... I wipe, I wipe... too high, I can't reach!
:{{DIcon}} About the [[Resonance Nexus|Genesis Nexus]]...
:'''Figaro:''' This Genesis Nexus, isn't it magnificent? They say it has existed since before our civilization. It's an engineering marvel achievable only through the [[Imperator|Sentinel]]'s divine work!
:'''Figaro:''' The most unique ability of the Genesis Nexus is to allow the Echoes within its Data Bank to exist in a tangible state for an extended period.
:'''Figaro:''' The Sentinel once bestowed Their authority upon the Order, granting them control over the Genesis Nexus and the ownership of the Echoes within its Data Bank.
:'''Figaro:''' Certainly, based on the benevolent and compassionate principles of the Sentinel, we have shared the use of [[Common Echoes]] with the people, hoping Their miracles will spread across the land.
:'''Figaro:''' I am only responsible for the basic maintenance of the Genesis Nexus. For specific issues regarding the Echo within the Data Bank, you can consult Acolyte [[Tulio]] of the Servitude Hall.
:'''Figaro:''' He often comes here to deposit frequency samples for the Genesis Nexus. But his duties with the Servitude Hall keep him busy; to see Acolyte Tulio, you'll need a bit of luck.
----
{{Stub|Double check accuracy, add {{sic}} to any grammar mistakes.}}
;(After Tulio disappearance)
:'''Figaro:''' Tulio, oh, Tulio...
:'''Figaro:''' Where has Acolyte Tulio been lately?
:'''Figaro:''' Tulio... sigh... I must admit, among the Servitude Hall, he has the deepest knowledge of Echoes.
:'''Figaro:''' He is passionate about the Echo, unwavering loyal to the Sentinel, and leads by example in everything he does... yet he is so... obstinate...
:'''Figaro:''' Fae Ignis migrations have already happened several times. If this isn't an isolated case, then Rinascita's Echoes and Tacet Discords may all be affected to varying degrees.
:'''Figaro:''' At his strong insistence, the Servitude Hall reported the matter to the higher-ups of the Order and proposed organizing a field investigation of the Penitent's End.
:'''Figaro:''' The Order's leadership, however, did not approve this plan for various reasons.
:'''Figaro:''' Who knows, Tulio went alone to Penitent's End one night... and never returned...
:'''Figaro:''' How could this be...
:'''Figaro:''' Perhaps he's still alive...
:'''Figaro:''' Perhaps he isn't dead... I hope... maybe he just lost his way in the island's mist...
:'''Figaro:''' Yes, maybe he isn't dead... I share that hope... perhaps he's just lost in the mist...
:'''Figaro:''' O' dear Sentinel, if you ever looked upon us, please grant this devout Acolyte peace and protection... bring this lost soul back to us...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
* There is a bug where Figaro appears in both his previous and new location after the disappearance of Tulio. Only his previous location self can be interacted with.
